verdict.rationale: Privacy posture is a fair question for a skill bundle shipped through an installer CLI and agent plugin marketplaces, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any way to opt out. Statements like "Nothing updates behind your back" are about update behavior, not data collection, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
